subject: Recap: pricing options & next steps for route expansion
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@freightfield.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: pricing options & next steps for route expansion

Thanks again for the time earlier today, Sarah — I appreciate the clear context on the three new routes you're looking to bring online and the timing constraints for Q3. Below is a short recap and the next steps we discussed so we can move toward a formal quote.

Call recap
- Scope: add two lane-specific generation routes (route-A and route-B) and a new summary model route for driver ETA messages.
- Current baseline: ~12M tokens/month across existing routes; estimated incremental for new routes: 35–55M tokens/month (conservative to high).
- Target unit economics you mentioned: ~$900 / 1M tokens as an ideal target for blended pricing; procurement prefers a 12–18 month committed program if pricing is favorable.
- Key constraints: predictable per-route latency (<= 200ms p95) and audit logs for compliance.

What we said we'd do (next steps)
1) Internal: we'll run a blended-rate exercise and propose step-up bands that reflect committed volume + burst. Karthik will share a draft pricing table by tomorrow.
2) External: Sarah to confirm the 35–55M incremental token range and which of the two new routes will be prioritized for Q3. Also flag any hard budget ceilings.
3) If agreed, we'll produce a short proposal + contract term options (12/24 months) and a DocuSign-ready quote.

Attachments: brief call notes attached.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
Attachment: call-notes-ff-0411.txt

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@freightfield.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T20:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: pricing options & next steps for route expansion

Connor — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of clarifications from our side so Karthik has exact bands to work against:
- Incremental estimate: route-A (driver ETA summaries): 20–30M tokens/month; route-B (lane messaging): 15–25M tokens/month. Combine that with existing ~12M gives us ~47–67M total in the first 3 months.
- Budget: our procurement team has signaled comfort up to $1,000 / 1M tokens for short-term pilot, but long-term target is $850–900 / 1M for a committed program. If the blended price can be <= $900 with a 12–18 month commitment, we can move faster.
- We will likely prioritize route-A for the initial rollout — route-B is phase 2.

Procurement note: please include a standard SLA and a simple data-processing addendum. I'll loop in procurement@freightfield.com if/when we have a draft.

Thanks,
Sarah Lee
Head of Product Operations | FreightField Logistics
sarah.lee@freightfield.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing options (draft) — blended & step-up bands for FreightField

Sarah / Connor — following our recap, attached is a short draft that maps the token bands and blended examples. High level summary below; see attached pricing-breakdown-0412.csv and the PDF for a clean quote.

Assumptions (please confirm)
- Combined tokens (existing + new routes) month 1: 47–67M; steady-state months 2–12: 60–120M depending on adoption.
- Target latency & features: standard p95 <= 200ms, KV caching for summaries, full audit logs retained 90 days.

Draft pricing (per 1M tokens) — committed 12-month term examples
- Band A: 0–50M: $1,100 / 1M tokens (on-demand baseline for pilot)
- Band B: 50–200M: $720 / 1M tokens (volume discount)
- Band C: 200M+: $500 / 1M tokens (deep-commit tier)

Blended examples (month-level)
- Conservative month (47M total): blended = ((47*$1100)/47) ≈ $1,100 / 1M (pilot-level)
- Mid adoption month (60M total): blended = (50*$1100 + 10*$720)/60 ≈ $1,020 / 1M
- Upside month with partial commit (120M total with 60M committed): blended ≈ $820 / 1M

Proposal to hit Sarah's $850–900 target
- Option 1 (12mo): Commit to 75M average monthly (12-mo term) -> blended ~ $900 / 1M. Credit structure: monthly invoice with a true-up at quarter-end.
- Option 2 (24mo): Commit to 60M average monthly -> blended ~ $820 / 1M + staging credits for onboarding.

Adding new routes / blended treatment
- When route-A and route-B are added, we combine consumption into the same billing pool. New model variants (smaller summary vs full generator) can be profiled and priced as route modifiers (typically 10–25% discount on generator model rates depending on latency SLA). We'll include separate line-items for route-A prioritization to ensure latency reserve.

Attachments: Redwood_FreightField_Proposal_0412.pdf, pricing-breakdown-0412.csv

Next steps
1) Sarah: confirm which option (12 vs 24 mo) you want us to draft formally and your acceptable blended target (900 is doable with a 75M commit).
2) Connor / Karthik: we'll prepare a DocuSign quote and a draft SLA + DPA for procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: pricing-breakdown-0412.csv

Please send the DocuSign quote and I'll route to procurement@freightfield.com for signature routing. Looking forward to the PDF.

Best,
